description.en: The ID of the resource group.

descriptions.zh: 调用该接口删除应用前，必须确保应用的状态为`释放成功`（`Destroyed_Success`），否则删除失败。可以调用<props="china">[GetApplication](~~428265~~)</props><props="intl">[GetApplication](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/bp-studio/latest/api-bpstudio-2021-09-31-getapplication)</props>查询应用状态。
descriptions.en: Before you delete an application, its status must be `Destroyed_Success`. Otherwise, the deletion fails. You can call <props="intl">[GetApplication](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/bp-studio/latest/api-bpstudio-2021-09-31-getapplication)</props> to query the application status.
